description: The header nav (Harness Arena | Leaderboard | How it works | Submit | Voice) has no entry for /voice/results. The only in-app path to results is the 'View results →' link shown on the done-state screen after finishing or skipping through a whole session. A researcher who lands on /voice but doesn't want to sit through 5-40 comparisons has no discoverable UI path to the results table — they would need to already know the /voice/results URL.
expected: A discoverable path to results that doesn't require completing (or skipping through) an entire evaluation session — e.g. a 'Results' nav entry or a persistent link from the /voice page itself.
actual: Results is reachable only via the post-session done-state link or direct URL knowledge; verified by inspecting the header nav on both /voice and /voice/results — both show the identical 5-item list with no results/analytics entry.
suggested_fix: Add a 'Results' link to the header nav (or a secondary link near the Voice Arena intro copy on /voice) pointing to /voice/results.

criterion: One way per task / dead ends (rubric 11)
description: /voice/results has no link back to /voice — the only route back is the ambient header 'Voice' nav link, not a dedicated in-content link. This matches the story's documented edge case ('one-directional: /voice/results has no link back to /voice').
expected: A direct link/button on the results page back to the arena, in addition to the header nav.
actual: No such link exists on the results page; navigation back relies entirely on the persistent header nav, which does work correctly (verified: clicking 'Voice' from /voice/results navigates to /voice).
suggested_fix: Low priority since the header nav link works reliably; would only matter if the header nav were ever removed or hidden on this page.
